description: A suite of Paragraph bundles made with the w3css framework.

 Successor projects: Solo and Paragraphs Bundles 
 The W3CSS theme evolved into Solo , and W3CSS Paragraphs evolved into Paragraphs Bundles . Existing sites can continue using W3CSS Paragraphs; new projects should also evaluate the successor projects.

 Solo provides: 

 
 Expanded theme configuration 
 Responsive layout and presentation controls 
 Integration with Paragraphs Bundles 
 
 View the Solo project 

 Review the successor projects and migration guidance before changing an existing site.

 Upgrade videos: Part One - Part Two 

 
 Back to top 

 The Solo theme and Paragraphs Bundles module for Drupal 
 Some Paragraphs Bundles display patterns are also available as Drupal Views styles in the Vanilla Views suite. The ten modules use vanilla JavaScript and provide Accordion , Basic Carousel , 3D Carousel , 3D FlipBox , Hero , Lightbox , Parallax , Reveal , Slideshow , and Tabs .
